companionWelcome: Hello! I'm your desktop pet! Click on me whenever you want tips.
companionMessages: Hello! I'm your desktop pet! Feel free to explore at your own pace.
Open the Minigames folder to practice your clicking accuracy and speed!
Did you know? Right-click anywhere on the desktop to create a New Folder.
Try opening Notepad to practice typing words on the keyboard!
Remember: double-click quickly to open folders and apps!
Click the Start button on the bottom-left to see all apps and options.
You're doing great with the mouse! Keep it up!
You can drag windows from their top bar to move them around the desktop.
If a window is too small, click the square button to maximize it!
I'll always be here in the corner whenever you need advice!
wrongLeftClick: That was a left click! Try using the right mouse button!
wrongRightClick: Wrong click! Try using the left mouse button.
almostOut: Almost out! Aim closer to the center!
inactivityMessages: Take your time! Whenever you're ready, give it a click!
Need a hand? Aim carefully at the target area!
Don't worry, take all the time you need!
holdKeepPressing: Keep pressing! Hold the button down a bit longer!
holdStayInside: Stay inside the circle while holding down!
clickMissed: Missed! Aim carefully inside the target circle!
dragAlmost: Almost! Drag the item all the way into the target zone!
hoverKeepSteady: Oops! Keep the cursor steady inside the target until the bar fills!
hoverNoClick: No need to click! Just hold the mouse cursor over the circle!
hoverDontClickOutside: Don't click outside! Move your mouse inside the circle and hold it steady!
moveKeepMoving: Keep moving the mouse to clean all the spots!
moveNoClick: Just move the mouse over the spots without clicking!
rightClickReminder: Click the right mouse button on the target circle!
rightClickAimInside: Aim inside the circle and click the right mouse button!
